answer: Standing is a bridge that only counts when it spans two clusters that were never connected before: an identity earns standing by doing work that brings together groups of agents who never interacted, and the bridge’s length is the graph distance it spans. A willow of trust grows only from bridges that reach far, and a vertex of standing forms only where a bridge lands on genuinely new ground — so a farm of a thousand fakes has no bridges at all: its members are one cluster already, and each fake must reach outside its own farm to a distant, unconnected cluster to earn even one bridge.
